title: Exclude fixed signed-caller QUERY and odd-idle edits (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the exact #7113 caller used by #7277, the relative q-sign product excludes all 15 nonempty Type A subsets of QUERY removals and all 15 nonempty Type B subsets of rank-nine odd-idle demotions to rank eight. Both scopes keep the 17 J blocks and the original 36-role ports and permit arbitrary invertible q-even ordinary mixing within each port. Zero subsets remain unresolved.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. The relative defect rank and slack argument is separate from #7144's body-gauge rigidity, #7295's rank-additive idle capacity and #7296's erased-child volume floor. The exact price grants free ancillary work in the upper. The optimistic maxima before support are 384 raw units for Type A and about 31.63562 for Type B. The complete compatible upper after support is zero in either scope.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-signed-caller-relative-defect-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-signed-caller-relative-defect-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

The replay saves the exact directed 17-copy prices first and checks both original q-sign endpoints and all 30 literal mutations. Type A needs total defect rank at least 38. Type B has eight determinant exclusions, one strict rank exclusion and six saturation exclusions. The clean local registered, committed modes and source history, official Git-free export, and six navigation checks passed. A corrupted caller was rejected. Two inherited #7257 CI commits enable hosted replay.

## Credit

#7113 supplies the signed caller and exact phase reference. #7277 at ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea supplies the signed invoice and remains the strongest independently reproduced comparable witness at κ = 0.003645669928698. Credit #7144, #7295 and #7296 for the related body, idle stock and volume results, and #7298 for the retained input blobs. Earlier Type A work used body derivatives under a different contract. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Changed J factors, new q-odd work, cross-port mixing and larger endpoint spaces remain open. A concrete continuation is to price a changed paid provider with higher relative phase rank on the complete signed invoice before any physical build.
